about: Data vault (bullets): what the app records besides the minute-by-minute prices of every streamed instrument. stock_chains_every_min: a full option chain (every strike, both sides: price, bid, ask, OI, volume, IV, delta) for every F&O stock, spread over each interval; index chains are recorded every time the app fetches them (every 3-6 minutes). The sweep only uses spare Upstox calls: it waits whenever more than max_upstox_share of the app's 30-minute Upstox budget is in use, so live prices and your own option-chain views always come first. context_every_min: breadth, sectors, day types, VIX, GIFT Nifty, world markets and the index option facts, saved together. Every headline the app sees is saved as it arrives. All of it lands in data/recordings (one set of files per day, compressed at the close) for backtests.
